description: Methane Emissions from Natural Gas Infrastructure and Use in the Urban Region of Boston, Massachusetts is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Kathryn McKain, Adrian Down. Archival datasets associated with with the paper McKain K, et al. (2015), including: continuous atmospheric methane and ethane concentration observations, and inventories of methane emissions by source type and natural gas consumption. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2015. Formats: TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (the dataset page says only that it "is made available with limited information on how it can be used"). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
